figurative_meaning_en: to remain secret, to keep something hidden inside without revealing it
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার দুঃখ মনে মনে রেখেছে, কাউকে বলেনি।
এই রহস্য মনে মনে রাখো, বাইরে প্রকাশ করো না।
example_sentences_in_english: He kept his sorrow to himself and didn't tell anyone.
Keep this secret in your mind; don't reveal it outside.
note: This idiom emphasizes internal retention of thoughts or secrets, common in Bengali oral traditions.
